fields.description: Canvas is ours: near-white, roads drawn as channels rather than ribbons, made to be drawn on. Positron is quiet grey, Bright is a conventional road map, Liberty is closer to OpenStreetMap's own. Plain draws no background at all, which is what an air-gapped instance and a schematic have in common.
fields.label: Basemap

fields.description: Off leaves the shapes and takes away the words. A map with forty vehicles on it is often busy enough.
fields.label: Name places on the map

fields.description: Quiet drops buildings, land use and points of interest. Minimal keeps water, roads and boundaries and nothing else — the ground a route needs and no more.
fields.label: How much is drawn
